title: PC-05: the Koide relation holds for the charged leptons only

statements.text: The Koide relation holds for the charged leptons only.
statements.scope: a prediction candidate, not a frozen prediction row
statements.conditions: Where it stands: E-FRC-0057 finds $Q = \dfrac{m_e + m_\mu + m_\tau}{(\sqrt{m_e} + \sqrt{m_\mu} + \sqrt{m_\tau})^2} = 2/3$ for the charged leptons, E-FRC-0063 finds 0.85 and 0.73 for the up and down quarks, E-FRC-0065 finds the neutrinos below 2/3. All restate measured masses (L1). What it needs: a derived reason, then a value for a sector not yet measured.

standing.reason: a candidate: it has not passed the prediction gate
